resources.string: Lets Anu tap and type in an app when you ask it to do something there, such as adding a product to your cart. Anu reads an app\'s screen only during a task you approved, or once when you tap \"Ask Anu about this screen\", and only on this phone. It asks again before anything that sends or deletes, and it never buys or pays. A line at the top of the screen shows what Anu is doing, with a Stop button. While you talk with Anu in other apps, a pill at the bottom shows it, with Stop.
